note: Shipped DEFAULT path configuration for S0.6. Every value here is byte-identical to the string literal it replaced, so that externalisation is provably behaviour-preserving under the shipped default (TEEG_10 section 3.3). Changing a value here changes behaviour and is out of S0's scope; S0 moves the literal, it does not fix it.
format_rationale: JSON, not YAML. The roadmap and TEEG_00 say 'config/paths.yaml'. PyYAML is not in the standard library and pyproject.toml deliberately declares no dependencies pending B-4, with S0.8 owning the lockfiles; adopting a dependency here would pre-empt that decision and repeat the requirements.txt mistake the project already decided against. JSON is stdlib and matches the project's own idiom: ancestors.json, path_moves.json, phase_hashes.json, every s0_transform/*.json and every schema in io/schemas/. Recorded as decision N-19; the deviation from the roadmap's stated filename is declared, not silent.

connectomics_dir.description: Working directory of the connectome build: holds conn.pkl on input and receives generate_microcolumn_cells and extract_connectivity_dicts output. Four of the five externalised occurrences resolve to this key.
connectomics_dir.trailing_separator: PRESERVED. The literal ends in '/' and call sites concatenate onto it without inserting one. Stripping it would be a behaviour change.

connectomics_output_dir.description: Output directory passed to Connectomics.__init__ as connectomics_output; the embryo of instances/col_{h}/ (TEEG_00 section 6, which requires it be externalised rather than deleted).
connectomics_output_dir.spelling_warning: The DIRECTORY is 'Connectomic_output', singular, while the VARIABLE at the call site is 'connectomics_output', plural. TEEG_00 section 6 names the variable. Shipping 'Connectomics_output' here would break behaviour preservation while looking correct.

drive_mount.rationale: This is a Colab API call, not a configurable path. '/content/drive' is the fixed mount point the google.colab runtime provides; it is not something a deployment chooses. Externalising it would create a configuration key that must never be changed, which is worse than leaving the call visible. It belongs to the de-Colab work, not to paths.json. Flagged in TEEG_10 section 4.1 ('count it separately') and excluded by name in s06_exit_scope.json.

package_relative_resources.rationale: Declared in s05_exit_scope.json under package_relative_resource_access. A package locating its own data inside itself is not configuration; a package that had to be told where its own schemas live would be misconfigured rather than flexible. S0.6's sweep honours that declaration.
